name: io.github.ssd7830-cmyk/korean-firefighter-law-mcp
title: Korean Fire Safety Law & Statistics
description: Korean fire safety law, statutes, NFPC/NFTC codes, hazmat, and fire/EMS statistics.

environmentVariables.name: DATA_GO_KR_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Service key from data.go.kr (Korean public data portal). Required for National Fire Agency APIs: fire status, EMS statistics, fire-safety buildings, facilities, and hazardous materials.

environmentVariables.name: LAW_OC
environmentVariables.description: OC identifier from open.law.go.kr (Korean Ministry of Government Legislation). Required for statutes, annexes, precedents, and administrative rules.
